name: Dr. Ambairam Muthu Sivakrishna
title: Assistant Professor (Grade II)
org: National Institute of Technology Karnataka, Surathkal
headline: Trustworthy AI & Cybersecurity · Machine Unlearning · Formal Verification
bio:
Dr. Ambairam Muthu Sivakrishna is an Assistant Professor (Grade II) in the Department of Information Technology at the National Institute of Technology Karnataka, Surathkal. He received his Ph.D. in Computer Science and Engineering from the National Institute of Technology Tiruchirappalli in March 2026, with a doctoral coursework CGPA of 9.5. He holds an M.Tech. in Software Engineering from the Indian Institute of Information Technology Tiruchirappalli and a B.Tech. in Information Technology from MITS Madanapalle, affiliated to JNTU Anantapur. He was awarded the Institute Gold Medal for his M.Tech. and the University Gold Medal for securing First Rank in his B.Tech. programme.

His research focuses on developing secure, reliable and interpretable intelligent systems. His interests span Trustworthy AI and Cybersecurity, theoretical analysis of neural networks, machine unlearning for secure AI, formal specification and verification systems, and neuro-symbolic and quantum-inspired learning models. His work in insider threat detection and behavioural cybersecurity examines how learning methods can support dependable security decisions.

Before joining NITK Surathkal, he served as an Assistant Professor at Alliance University, Bengaluru, and as Temporary Faculty at IIIT Tiruchirappalli.
